battle.name: 巴勒斯坦大起義
battle.brief: 巴勒斯坦大起義於一九八七年十二月在加薩地帶興起，隨後擴展至約旦河西岸，形成反對以色列佔領的罷工、抗議與武裝抗爭；英國海軍的蒸汽鐵甲艦（Steam ironclad）於一八六五年列裝，屬遠洋戰艦與護航兵力。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦是英國海軍十九世紀中葉的主力遠洋戰艦，配備大口徑火砲，負責海上砲擊、封鎖與護航，並作為遠征艦隊的火力核心。

countries: 1987年12月9日之後，加沙地帶與約旦河西岸的衝突，實際上是巴勒斯坦抵抗運動各派與以色列國防軍之間一場沒有統一戰線的城市戰。以色列方面由南部司令部節制，加沙走廊編入第九師，師轄加沙旅，配一個坦克營（裝M60A1與M60A3／Magach 7型，掛TOW發射器）與一個工兵營，即第601營「阿舒爾之熱」（חומי אשור）；1988年初各難民營入口架設的鋼製閘門與石堆路障，就是該營與預備役工程連施工。軍法與情報由辛貝特局長烏里・薩維爾（Uri Savir）主導，逮捕、驅逐與行政拘留多依據軍事命令執行；1987年12月的國防部長是伊胡德・巴拉克（Ehud Barak），總參謀長為阿姆農・利普金－沙哈克（Amnon Lipkin-Shahak），1990年由舒穆埃爾・馬克萊夫（Shmuel Maklef）接任。巴勒斯坦方面沒有總指揮部：法塔赫在加沙以優素福・納賈爾（Yusuf al-Najjar）與阿卜杜勒・瓦哈卜・哈提卜（Abdel Wahab al-Khatib）為骨幹，人民解放陣線中央在安曼，由喬治・哈巴什（George Habbash）主持，巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭抵抗運動則靠被關押在以色列的謝赫・艾哈邁德・亞辛（Sheikh Ahmed Yassin）以聲明遙控，直到1988年3月「全國拯救陣線」成立，兩岸武裝小組才第一次有共同協調架構。
countriesEn: From 9 December 1987, the fighting in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank was in practice an urban war without a unified front between the Palestinian resistance factions and the Israel Defense Forces. On the Israeli side the Southern Command held overall control, with the Gaza corridor assigned to the Ninth Division, which fielded the Gaza Brigade, a tank battalion (M60A1 and M60A3/Magach 7 tanks carrying TOW launchers) and a combat-engineering battalion, the 601st Heat of Ashur (חומי אשור); the steel gates and rubble blockades erected at the entrances of the refugee camps in early 1988 were built by that battalion together with reserve engineering companies. Justice and intelligence ran through Shin Bet director Uri Savir, with arrests, expulsions and administrative detentions carried out under military orders; the defense minister in December 1987 was Ehud Barak, and the chief of staff was Amnon Lipkin-Shahak, succeeded by Shmuel Maklef in 1990. The Palestinians had no general command: Fatah's organizers in Gaza were Yusuf al-Najjar and Abdel Wahab al-Khatib, the central command of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine sat in Amman under George Habbash, and the Palestinian Islamic Resistance relied on Sheikh Ahmed Yassin, held in Israeli custody, who issued statements rather than orders; only with the formation of the National Salvation Front in March 1988 did armed groups on both sides acquire a common coordinating structure.
people: 先鋒人物是加沙耶巴利亞難民營的優素福・納賈爾。1987年12月8日夜至9日凌晨，他與營內一批青年聚集在通往加沙市的幹道與營區入口公路的檢查點附近，以軍攔停並搜查一輛載有多人的車輛，青年開始投擲石塊與燃燒瓶，士兵以實彈與催淚瓦斯反擊，納賈爾頭部重傷送入希法醫院；受傷成因事後說法不一，有稱石塊擊中，也有稱遭發射物撞擊，但他的傷勢影像在營內流傳，成為第一波動員的符號。12月18日，阿卜杜勒・瓦哈卜・哈提卜在加沙一座清真寺宣布總罷工，這一天被記為起義的第一個政治高峰。12月21日至22日，以軍封閉耶路撒冷老城阿克薩清真寺院區，院內發生械鬥，一名以軍士兵遭斧頭砍傷，數日後因傷勢與休克死亡；12月25日，一名巴勒斯坦計程車司機在老城巷道用斧頭擊殺兩名以軍士兵。與此同時，艾哈邁德・亞辛自1983年起遭以色列監禁，只能透過律師與獄中聲明指導哈瑪斯與1988年3月成立的「全國拯救陣線」；人民解放陣線的哈利德・哈桑（阿布・吉哈德）則在1988年4月16日於突尼斯被以色列情報單位在「青年之春」行動中狙殺。
peopleEn: Yusuf al-Najjar of the Jabalia camp was the first man whose name the movement carried. On the night of 8 December 1987 into the early hours of 9 December, he and a group of camp youths gathered near the checkpoint on the road leading into Gaza City, where soldiers stopped and searched a vehicle carrying several people. Stones and incendiary bottles were thrown, the soldiers answered with live rounds and tear gas, and al-Najjar was struck in the head and taken to al-Shifa hospital. Accounts differ on the exact cause of his wound, some saying a stone and others a thrown canister, but images of his injuries spread through the camp and became the symbol of the first wave of mobilization. On 18 December, Abdel Wahab al-Khatib announced a general strike from a mosque in Gaza, a day remembered as the first political summit of the uprising. On 21 and 22 December, Israeli troops sealed the al-Aqsa compound in the Old City of Jerusalem; fighting inside the compound left an Israeli soldier cut down with an axe, and he died of his wounds and shock several days later. On 25 December, a Palestinian taxi driver killed two Israeli soldiers with an axe in the narrow lanes of the Old City. Meanwhile, Sheikh Ahmed Yassin, in Israeli custody since 1983, directed Hamas and the National Salvation Front formed in March 1988 through lawyers and prison statements, while Khalid al-Hassan (Abu Jihad) of the PFLP was shot dead in Tunis on 16 April 1988 by an Israeli intelligence unit in Operation Spring of Youth.
kits: 以軍裝備以1980年代制式為主：步兵使用以色列自行仿製的M16A1／EMTAN型5.56×45毫米步槍，機槍為FN MAG 58（7.62×51毫米）與M2勃朗寧重機槍，裝甲為Merkava Mk.3（MG251型120毫米滑膛炮）與M60A1、M60A3／Magach 7坦克，砲兵使用Soltam 120毫米迫擊砲與81毫米迫擊砲；巡邏用M151A1越野吉普與M998 HMMWV，坦克與HMMWV均可掛TOW導彈。反暴動裝備包括「雲」（ענן，Cloud）CS催淚手榴彈、以色列編號BAL的催淚發煙罐，以及從步槍槍口發射的加厚橡膠彈與5.56毫米實彈。軍需由南部司令部後勤單位以卡車車隊自以色列本土沿走廊運入，油料每日由油罐車補充，1988年後加沙各營入口加裝鋼門、路障與巡查燈柱。巴勒斯坦一方可用的實質裝備則是石塊、彈弓、裝有燃油與布條引信的玻璃瓶燃燒瓶、土製炸藥包，以及少量自舊軍械庫與黑市取得的AK-47、FN FAL步槍與衝鋒槍；通訊靠人手傳話、手提無線電與清真寺公告，後勤補給線極短，燃料與彈藥多靠加沙市商號與約旦河西岸走私小徑取得。
kitsEn: The Israeli inventory was standard 1980s issue. Infantry carried the locally produced M16A1/EMTAN 5.56x45mm rifle; machine guns were the FN MAG 58 in 7.62x51mm and the M2 Browning heavy machine gun; armor consisted of the Merkava Mk.3 with its MG251 120mm smoothbore gun and M60A1 and M60A3/Magach 7 tanks; artillery included Soltam 120mm and 81mm mortars. Patrols used M151A1 jeeps and M998 HMMWVs, the latter fielded from the mid-1980s, and TOW missiles could be mounted on tanks and HMMWVs. Crowd-control equipment included the Cloud (ענן) CS grenade, the Israeli-designated BAL riot and smoke canister, thick rubber bullets fired from rifle muzzles, and standard 5.56mm live ammunition. Logistics ran through Southern Command supply units, with truck convoys moving from Israel proper along the corridor, fuel topped up daily by tankers, and from 1988 the entrances of Gaza's refugee camps gaining steel gates, roadblocks and floodlight masts. On the Palestinian side the material inventory was stones, slingshots, glass incendiary bottles with fuel and cloth wicks, improvised explosive charges, and a small number of AK-47 and FN FAL rifles and submachine guns obtained from old surplus depots and the black market. Communications depended on couriers, handheld radios and mosque announcements; supply lines were extremely short, with fuel and ammunition moving through Gaza traders and small smuggling routes across the West Bank.
tactics: 起義初期，巴勒斯坦方面的戰術核心是群體對峙：每天在早班交接與傍晚外出兩個時段，集中於市郊路口與營區入口，用石塊與燃燒瓶驅趕巡邏，用翻倒的鐵桶、油料與碎石堆成路障，使以軍車隊被迫停車或改道；耶路撒冷則在阿克薩院區與老城巷道的狹窄地形中，以短距離襲擊與投擲物消耗士兵耐心，之後才演變成對巡邏與哨所的夜襲。以軍的應對是先驅散、後鎮壓：先用催淚瓦斯與橡膠彈劃出封鎖線，再以機槍、實彈與坦克封住路口，多數死亡案例發生在士兵以實彈還擊投擲物之際；配合情報單位提供的名單進行突擊逮捕，以行政拘留與驅逐令清除基層骨幹，並由工兵在難民營入口構築封閉設施限制夜間通行。1989年至1991年間手段明顯升級：加沙出現以迫擊砲射擊建成區的報告，1991年3月的加沙對峙中以軍以實彈機槍射擊造成十餘人死亡，約旦河西岸則出現山區公路上的封鎖路障與襲擊哨所，早期以石塊與燃燒瓶為主的抵抗手段逐步被土製炸藥與槍擊取代。
tacticsEn: In the first weeks the Palestinian tactic was mass confrontation. At the morning shift change and in the evening when people left work, groups concentrated at junctions on the edge of town and at camp entrances, drove off patrols with stones and incendiary bottles, and blocked streets with overturned bins, fuel and rubble so that Israeli vehicles had to stop or detour. In Jerusalem, where the ground was the narrow alleys of the Old City and the al-Aqsa compound, short-range attacks and thrown objects wore down the soldiers' patience before raids on patrols and posts at night developed. The Israeli response was dispersal first and repression second: tear gas and rubber bullets drew a cordon, machine guns, live rounds and tanks sealed the junctions, and most deaths followed Israeli fire at people throwing stones. Arrests were made in raids based on lists supplied by the intelligence service, organizers were removed through administrative detention and expulsion orders, and combat engineers built sealed facilities at camp entrances to restrict movement after dark. From 1989 to 1991 the escalation was visible: mortar rounds were fired into built-up areas of Gaza, live machine-gun fire in the March 1991 Gaza confrontations killed more than ten people, and on the West Bank roadblocks on hill roads and attacks on posts replaced the earlier pattern, while stones and incendiary bottles slowly gave way to improvised explosives and gunfire.
data: 時間與數字可如此排列：1987年12月9日耶巴利亞爆發首場大規模衝突；12月11日至16日戰線擴至哈瓦吉拉、沙蒂與汗尤尼斯各營；12月18日加沙與河西岸同時罷工一天；12月21日至22日阿克薩院區被封閉並發生械鬥；12月25日老城斧頭襲擊致兩名以軍士兵死亡。1988年3月「全國拯救陣線」在伯利恆與加沙分別成立；4月16日哈利德・哈桑在突尼斯遇襲身亡；11月15日巴勒斯坦解放組織在阿爾及爾宣布成立巴勒斯坦國。1989年11月加沙北部努塞賴拉特一帶發生長達整日的對峙，巴方稱為「沙漠之戰」。傷亡數字雙方說法差距很大，貝特塞姆（B'Tselem）統計1987年12月至1993年底以軍造成約一千一百至一千三百名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中相當一部分死於向士兵投擲物時遭實彈射擊；以方統計約二百四十至二百六十名以色列人死亡，其中約六成為軍人。1987年加沙地帶人口約七十萬至八十萬，境內聯合國登記的難民營約八座，因此這場戰爭被形容為沒有統一戰術的群眾戰爭；直接參與街頭對峙者多為二十歲上下的青年。
dataEn: The chronology and figures can be set out this way. On 9 December 1987 the first large clash broke out in Jabalia; from 11 to 16 December the front widened to the Hawajira, al-Shati and Khan Yunis camps; on 18 December Gaza and the West Bank observed a one-day general strike; on 21 and 22 December the al-Aqsa compound was sealed and fighting broke out inside; on 25 December an axe attack in the Old City killed two Israeli soldiers. In March 1988 the National Salvation Front was founded in Bethlehem and in Gaza; on 16 April Khalid al-Hassan was killed in Tunis; on 15 November the Palestine Liberation Organization declared a Palestinian state in Algiers. In November 1989 a confrontation that lasted a full day ran through the Nusayrat area of northern Gaza, which Palestinians call the Battle of al-Sahra. Casualty figures differ sharply between the two sides: B'Tselem counts roughly 1,100 to 1,300 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces between December 1987 and the end of 1993, with a substantial share of them shot while throwing stones or throwing themselves at soldiers, while Israeli tallies put Israeli deaths at around 240 to 260, about six in ten of them soldiers. Gaza had roughly 700,000 to 800,000 inhabitants in 1987 and about eight UN-registered refugee camps, which is why the uprising is described as a popular war without a unified tactic; most of those in the street confrontations were in their twenties.
cause: 直接導火線很小。1987年12月8日夜，耶巴利亞營內青年因一輛車在營區入口被攔查而聚集投擲石塊，以軍哨兵以實彈與催淚瓦斯驅散，衝突延續到9日清晨，成為全面起義的引爆點。但根源在1967年之後的結構：以色列控制加沙與河西岸並持續推進移民點，徵地、繞道公路、軍用場地與檢查站分割城鎮，約旦河西岸的通行許可制度限制民眾求職與出行；1980年代加沙出口與水資源分配依賴以色列，青年人口比例偏高而工作機會稀少；1982年黎巴嫩戰役之後，法塔赫與人陣的武裝路線受挫，伊斯蘭抵抗運動在清真寺與校園的組織度上升。沙米爾內閣則把維持秩序視為軍隊的職責，攝影機把石塊飛向頭盔的畫面帶進每一戶人家，使一名青年對抗整支軍隊的影像成為政治燃料。
causeEn: The immediate spark was small. On the night of 8 December 1987, youths in Jabalia gathered after a vehicle was stopped at the camp entrance and stones were thrown at the sentries, who answered with live fire and tear gas; the fighting ran into the morning of the 9th and became the trigger for a general uprising. But the roots lie in the structure imposed after 1967. Israel controlled Gaza and the West Bank and continued to expand settlements, taking land for bypass roads and military sites, while permits and closures fragmented the West Bank towns and restricted where Palestinians could work and travel. In the 1980s Gaza depended on the Israeli market and on water allocations, the youth population was swollen and jobs scarce, and after the 1982 Lebanon war the armed strategy of Fatah and the PFLP had stalled, so that the Islamic resistance groups gained organizational strength in mosques and on campuses. Under the Shamir government the official line insisted that restoring order was the army's duty, and television crews carried images of stones thrown at helmets into living rooms, turning the picture of one youth facing an army into political fuel.
impact: 起義改變了雙方的政治語言。以色列在國際上的形象急轉直下，1987年11月5日聯合國大會通過第42/217號決議要求調查加沙事件，美國國會與歐洲議會隨後以聽證會與決議回應；沙米爾內閣遭到國內批評，軍方高層對射擊政策的分歧擴大，總參謀長利普金－沙哈克主張在有人受傷時保持克制，但國防部長巴拉克仍以恢復秩序為最高原則。巴勒斯坦方面則獲得難得的合法性：法塔赫在加沙重組基層，人陣與哈瑪斯因共同抵抗而並肩，1988年11月15日解放組織在阿爾及爾宣布建立巴勒斯坦國，宣示國家性；1980年代末歐洲與日本的民間團體及工會組織到加沙現場見證，學生運動把起義視為反殖民抵抗的樣板。戰術層面，1988年起土製炸藥與槍械逐漸排擠石塊成為象徵；1990年耶路撒冷日把焦點從加沙推向被占的耶路撒冷；1991年1月海灣戰爭爆發後，加沙自3月17日起重燃對峙，十餘人死亡，以色列國內也爆發要求停止起義的總罷工。
impactEn: The uprising changed the political language on both sides. Israel's standing abroad fell sharply; on 5 November 1987 the UN General Assembly adopted Resolution 42/217 demanding an investigation into the Gaza events, and the US Congress and the European Parliament answered with hearings and resolutions. The Shamir cabinet drew domestic criticism, disagreement inside the military leadership over the rules of engagement widened, Chief of Staff Amnon Lipkin-Shahak argued for restraint whenever casualties were reported, though Defense Minister Ehud Barak kept restoration of order as the stated top priority. The Palestinians gained legitimacy they had not held before: Fatah rebuilt its base in Gaza, the PFLP and Hamas stood side by side in common resistance, and on 15 November 1988 the PLO declared a Palestinian state in Algiers, announcing a national existence. In the late 1980s European and Japanese civil society groups and trade unions traveled to Gaza to witness events, and student movements in the West and in the Islamic world read the uprising as a model of anti-colonial resistance. Tactically, from 1988 improvised explosives and firearms increasingly displaced stones as the symbol of action; in 1990 Jerusalem Day shifted the focus from Gaza to occupied Jerusalem; when the Gulf War broke out in January 1991, Gaza relit on 17 March with more than a dozen dead, and Israel itself saw a general strike demanding an end to the uprising.
result: 軍事上這場戰爭沒有勝負可言。以軍保住加沙與河西岸的全部控制區，沒有任何部隊被逐出任何城鎮；巴方的既定目標，也就是終結1967年占領並取得國家地位，在起義期間一寸未得；代價是一千一百至一千三百名巴勒斯坦人與二百多名以色列人死亡，加沙市與各營入口則被鐵門與路障永久改造成檢查站格局，宵禁與路檢制度成為日常。政治上耗損帶來轉向：1991年馬德里會議重啟談判，1993年9月13日在華盛頓，拉賓與阿拉法特握手並簽署秘密協議，1994年開羅宣言與加沙－耶里科自治協議生效，1993年至1995年間街頭暴力逐漸收斂，多數武裝小組解散或轉入政治鬥爭，河西岸山區與加沙邊界仍不時發生衝突。長期後果延伸到2000年9月28日，第二場起義延用同一套人海、封鎖與石塊的戰術手段，說明1987年之後的十三年，人們學會的是如何以身體對抗國家暴力，而不是如何取得國家。
resultEn: Militarily there was no winner. The IDF held every inch of Gaza and the West Bank, no unit was driven out of any town, and the Palestinian goal of ending the 1967 occupation and winning statehood advanced not a single inch during the uprising. The cost was the lives of 1,100 to 1,300 Palestinians and more than two hundred Israelis, and the entrances to Gaza City and its camps were permanently reshaped into checkpoint territory with iron gates, curfews and inspections on the roads. Politically, exhaustion brought a turn: the Madrid conference reopened negotiations in 1991, Rabin and Arafat shook hands in Washington on 13 September 1993 and signed the secret agreement, the Cairo Declaration and the Gaza-Jericho self-rule accord took effect in 1994, and between 1993 and 1995 the street violence of the uprising wound down as most armed groups dissolved or moved into political struggle, although clashes continued on the West Bank hills and along the Gaza border. The long-term consequence runs into 28 September 2000, when the Second Intifada used the same methods of crowds, roadblocks and stones, showing that in the thirteen years after 1987 people had learned how to confront state power with their own bodies, but not how to win a state.
